theme: multi-probe agent lease/lock: TOUCH + REALPATH + READ OR acquire/status/renew/release

tests.name: acquire
tests.note: agent.lock empty + agent.lease identity date; TOUCH_N=1

tests.name: renew_and_release
tests.note: TOUCH update TOUCH_N=0; RM both; second release idempotent

tests.name: realpath_missing_ok
tests.note: REALPATH OK=1 even when path does not exist

weaknesses.title: No atomic exclusive create (O_EXCL) — TOUCH lock is TOCTOU
weaknesses.detail: Acquire is ISFILE then TOUCH. Two agents can both see free and both TOUCH; second TOUCH_N=0 is only detected if we EXPECT create, but TOUCH never fails when file appears mid-race—it becomes an update. Not a real mutex vs flock/lockf. Agents still need shell flock for critical sections.
weaknesses.repro: two concurrent acquire processes on same CUBALC_STATE — both can 'succeed'

weaknesses.title: SYS REALPATH returns OK=1 for missing paths
weaknesses.detail: REALPATH/ABSPATH on a non-existent path still OK=1 and returns an absolute string (cwd-join or as-is). Agents cannot use REALPATH as existence proof; must pair EXIST/ISFILE. Easy to stamp lock_abs that does not yet exist and assume it is live.
weaknesses.repro: SYS REALPATH "/tmp/no_such"; ASSERT OK==1; SYS EXIST same → 0

weaknesses.title: No mtime/atime probe — cannot expire leases in-language
weaknesses.detail: TOUCH refreshes mtime but nothing reads mtime back. Lease expiry requires host date math or external watcher. TOUCH without STAT_MTIME cannot implement TTL locks purely in CubalC.
weaknesses.repro: want: if lock mtime older than N seconds then RM — no form

weaknesses.title: Lease body multi-CAT still painful for IDENTITY+DATE
weaknesses.detail: Three SYS CAT steps to build holder=… date=…. No format/sprintf. WRITE_JSON still missing for structured leases.

weaknesses.title: SYS JOIN still absent from forms/search
weaknesses.detail: Unfixed since iter7; every path worker hardcodes JOIN knowledge.

weaknesses.title: Busy lock EXIT 4 after FAIL still needs CLEAR for pure -s paths that continue
weaknesses.detail: EXIT non-zero is fine for CI, but if agents PASS after busy without EXIT, sticky FAIL remains. Documented pattern only.
weaknesses.repro: FAIL lock held; PASS; run -s without EXIT/CLEAR → rc=1

workarounds: Treat TOUCH lock as advisory only; use EXIT 4 busy for single-agent serial CI
Always EXIST/ISFILE after REALPATH before trusting a path is live
Host cron for TTL expiry until STAT_MTIME exists
SYS CAT chain for lease lines; VARS for full identity
EXIT non-zero on busy rather than soft continue under -s
language_gaps: SYS TOUCH EXCL / atomic create-only lock form
REALPATH that soft-fails or flags missing vs resolve-only
String format / WRITE_JSON for lease plates
Optional flock-backed SYS LOCK for real mutex
